hook: Twisting spacetime light lattices yields 3D moire patterns of knotted light called hopfion bags
hook_turn: yields 3D moire patterns of knotted light called hopfion bags
summary: The work builds 3D moire superlattices by twisting spatiotemporal optical lattices, producing hopfion bags, hopfion quasicrystals and nested hopfion superlattices. Tuning the interference polarization textures switches between these states and sets their topological numbers. The abstract does not say how much is measured versus simulated, and the information-encoding use is only proposed.
title: Hopfion Superlattices in 3D Twisted Moir\'e Light Fields
